spirit.description1: Our exquisite rosso vermouth and bianco vermouth are born from the rarest, hand selected rose petals from the Monégasque rose gardens, a prized sanctuary of elegance and refinement.
spirit.description2: Its distinctive palate enchants with the delightful interplay of Moscato d’Asti DOCG grapes from Italy’s renowned Piedmont region and the highest quality botanicals from the Côte d’Azur’s aromatic heartland, Grasse. This unique blend of flavours, aromas, precious ingredients and ancestral craft fully expresses the best of French, Italian and Monégasque savoir-faire.

premiumGrapes.title: Premium Grapes
premiumGrapes.text: Monte-Carlo Vermouth is created using artisanal methods of vermouth making from the renowned Piedmont region, whose vineyards are listed among the UNESCO World Heritage. Expert Italian winemakers create Moscato d’Asti DOCG to form an unparalleled aromatic base using the whole grape, grown expressly for this purpose.

botanicals.title: The Botanicals
botanicals.text: The liquid is then blended with Côte d’Azur botanicals exclusively from expert distillers in the perfume capital of the world, Grasse. Known around the globe for the quality of its fragrances since the 18th century, it is where the finest luxury perfumes are made.

monegasqueRoses.title: Monégasque Roses
monegasqueRoses.text: Finally, the liquid is made more exceptional with a touch of the Monégasque terroir: hand-picked rose petals from the principality’s rose garden to impart intrigue, elegance, and a divine taste.

craftsmanship.eyebrow: The Perfect Addition to Elegant Cocktail
craftsmanship.description: The light, highly aromatic and fresh palate of Monte Carlo Vermouth gives it great versatility to be enjoyed on its own on ice, or in cocktails to give renewed sophistication to a classic favourite.

mixology.description1: Enjoy Monte Carlo Vermouth simply on ice, with tonic, or in a selection of cocktails such as classics revisited and delightful innovations for the discerning palate.
mixology.description2: Created by our expert mixologist exclusively for Monte Carlo Vermouth, discover the next cocktails of the season.

gregoryBuda.quote: Monte Carlo Vermouth offers something fresh and unique to the entire category, and opens new doors for both cocktails and enjoying vermouth on its own.
gregoryBuda.position: Partner and Educator at "Bar Bisou Bisou", "Dead Rabbit" and "BlackTail"

lucaRubinacci.quote: Monte Carlo Vermouth, with its super-evocative top note of Monegasque roses, has become our favourite aperitif – light, distinctive and exquisitely balanced. It’s like a Mediterranean sunset in a glass.
lucaRubinacci.position: Creative Director of the Neapolitan Tailor House Rubinacci

slavaArakelov.quote: Monte Carlo Vermouth reflects the heritage and savoir-faire of Monaco, France and Italy. The two wine profiles of Moscato d’Asti DOCG and Langhe Nebbiolo DOC distinguish themselves by their perfect balance and finesse, with a surprising light and delicate end note of rose.
slavaArakelov.position: Chef Sommelier Wine Palace Monte Carlo

matthiasGiroud.quote: What differentiates MCV from other vermouths is its use of high-quality ingredients and its unique signature that combines the worlds of perfume and wine. This blend brings a simple yet complex elegance, making it perfect for consumption neat or in cocktails.
matthiasGiroud.position: Co-founder of Alchimiste Group and Head Mixologist

wineParis2026.title: Meet Monte Carlo Vermouth at Wine Paris 2026
wineParis2026.text: From February 9 to 11, Paris once again becomes the global meeting point for the wine and spirits world.

merryChristmas.title: Merry Christmas from Monte Carlo Vermouth
merryChristmas.text: It’s almost Christmas and we would like to thank you all for learning about our product, taking the first sip and finally — falling in love with it! Let’s pour our Vermouth into a glass and wish each other a Merry Christmas — cin-cin!

bitterTincture.title: From Bitter Tincture To Sweet Trendsetter
bitterTincture.text: The basis of what vermouth is goes back to ancient times. However, the qualities for which it has been valued has changed significantly.

availableOnline.title: Monte Carlo Vermouth Available Online
availableOnline.text: The moment has finally arrived! We’ve opened online sales of Monte Carlo Vermouth in selected countries – a product created to embody the spirit of Monaco, as well as its lifestyle and refined taste.

chalet.title: Chalet Monte Carlo Vermouth
chalet.text: The magic of Christmas comes to Monaco. On this occasion, we are delighted to announce the opening of Monte Carlo Vermouth Chalet.

livingWall.title: Monte Carlo Vermouth Living Wall
livingWall.text: On September 3rd, we spent a delightful day at the party hosted by Club La Vigie Monte-Carlo, where we proudly presented our living wall.

storyBotanicals.subtitle: Monte Carlo Vermouth is infused with botanicals distilled in the historical and unique city of Grasse, the world’s perfume capital where the finest aromatics are born.
storyBotanicals.description1: The inimitable Monégasque rose petals are thus enhanced with a touch of Côte d’Azur florals including mimosa creating a harmony of nuances.
storyBotanicals.description2: Mediterranean citrus notes of mandarin, lemon peel, orange peel and grapefruit together for the refreshing backbone of Monte Carlo Vermouth, imparting the invigorating flavor of a sunset over the French Riviera.
storyBotanicals.description3: Treasured by the Ancient Egyptians who used it in incense and perfume, Orris root imbues a unique combination of sensations sometimes described as a delicate mix of violet and raspberry.
storyBotanicals.description4: Roman and white wormwood impart bitters so characteristic of vermouth. Indeed, the word vermouth itself is derived from the Old English wermod while the plant species, artemisia absinthium is named for the Ancient Greek goddess of the hunt and protectress of the forest.
storyBotanicals.description5: Underscoring these aromas are herbs and spices such as coriander, Sichuan pepper, Immortelle, and fresh ginger, that bring complexity, variety, and depth to the recipe. Together, they add the right amount of piquant to make each glass a new chapter in a never-ending story of Monte Carlo Vermouth.

storyGrapes.description: The Monte Carlo Vermouth is created using artisanal methods of vermouth making from the renowned Piedmont region, whose vineyards are listed among the UNESCO World Heritage. Expert Italian winemakers use Moscato d’Asti DOCG grapes to form an unparalleled aromatic base using the whole grape, grown expressly for this purpose.

storyRoses.description: Infused with hand-picked rose petals from the Monégasque rose gardens, renowned for their exquisite beauty and home to 168 rare rose varieties, Monte Carlo Vermouth captures the delicate fragrance of these exceptional flowers. Their captivating aroma brings a subtle floral elegance to every sip, reflecting the purity and sophistication of Monaco.

storyFinal.subtitle: THE ESSENCE OF MONACO
storyFinal.title: A TASTE OF THE RIVIERA
storyFinal.description: A celebration of exceptional botanicals, refined craftsmanship, and the timeless charm of Monte Carlo.

vermouthCulture.description1: Together Monte-Carlo and Monaco represent a unique blend born from the influence of their French and Italian neighbours throughout history, combined with fierce pride in tradition, savoir-faire and an inimitable epicurean lifestyle.
vermouthCulture.description2: Situated along the French Riviera a mere stone’s throw from the Italian border the Principality of Monaco is the cultural heart of the Riviera. For centuries, the Principality attracted people from all over the world seeking to discover the best experiences and to enjoy every moment of their life. This makes it the undisputable worldwide reference in the most rooted, refined and multicultural luxury.
vermouthCulture.description3: From the royal court of Turin centuries ago, to Hollywood’s cinematic icons or the Lost Generation of Hemingway, vermouth has always been celebrated by the truly discerning palate. Like the principality of Monaco, Monte Carlo Vermouth is proud of its heritage, its influences, and ancestral know-how, as it is the embodiment and culmination of the most refined craftsmanship and ingredients.
vermouthCulture.description4: Monte Carlo Vermouth is created using artisanal methods of vermouth making from the renowned Piedmont region, whose vineyards are listed among the UNESCO World Heritage. Expert Italian winemakers create Moscato d’Asti DOCG to form an unparalleled aromatic base using the whole grape, grown expressly for this purpose. The liquid is then blended with Côte d’Azur botanicals exclusively from expert distillers in the perfume capital of the world, Grasse. Known around the globe for the quality of its fragrances since the 18th century, it is where the finest luxury perfumes are made.
vermouthCulture.description5: Finally, the liquid is made more exceptional with a touch of the Monégasque terroir: hand-picked rose petals from the principality’s rose garden to impart intrigue, elegance, and a divine taste.
vermouthCulture.description6: Whether visiting for a whirlwind weekend of racing by day and Casino by night, or stationing your yacht to stay a while, one thing is for certain: the aura of Monte-Carlo becomes part of you. Crafted to bottle this singular spirit, Monte Carlo Vermouth is the ideal refreshment for everyday chic.

vermouthTasting.subtitle: CITRUS, FLORAL, AND DELICATE, WITH HINTS OF ROSE
vermouthTasting.description: Fruity on the nose with a palate of fresh citrus and hints of rose underscored by light bitter flavours and floral spice. The light, highly aromatic and fresh palate of Monte Carlo Vermouth gives it great versatility to be enjoyed on its own on ice, or in cocktails to give renewed sophistication to a classic favorite. Create the ultimate dry gin or vodka martini or try Monte Carlo Vermouth with prosecco or tonic over ice.
vermouthTasting.eyeDescription: Monte Carlo Vermouth enchants the eye with a ruby-blush hue.
vermouthTasting.noseDescription: Expressive and floral with jasmine, verbena, mimosa, and rose giving way to ripe fruity aromas of lychee, honeydew melon, and grapefruit.
vermouthTasting.palateDescription: On the palate, Monte Carlo Vermouth is invigorating and fruity with notes of bergamot, grapefruit zest, mandarin, and melon underscored by a hint of delightful bitterness reminiscent of grapefruit pith and bitter orange. Its full, rich, semi sweet body coats the mouth. A long and lingering finish on savoury flavours and herbs take over from the fruit as subtle rose evokes intrigue.

vermouthBottle.intro: The liquid is presented in a majestic crystal bottle, a work of art down to each detail.
vermouthBottle.closureDescription: The noble cork is secured with a bespoke rose gold medallion that recalls the first verse of the Monégasque anthem.
vermouthBottle.topLabelDescription: An echo of the flowers that infuse the treasure within, the golden rose is a reference to the unique palate of Monte Carlo Vermouth and principality’s iconic gardens.
vermouthBottle.centralLabelDescription: The emblematic central seal with the V monogram resonates the spirit of Monaco.

pearDrop.description: A refreshing and elegant twist on the classic Vermouth & Tonic, the Pear Drop combines the rich flavor of Monte Carlo Rosso with the delicate essence of pear. The cocktail is for those who prefer sweeter drinks and is inspired by the famous British confectionery of the same name. The addition of Grand Marnier brings a subtle orange complexity, perfectly balanced with the crispness of dry tonic water. Ideal for a sophisticated afternoon refreshment or a relaxing evening treat.
pearDrop.method: Pour all ingredients into an empty highball glass. Fill the glass with cubed ice and top with tonic water. Briefly mix the ingredients in the glass with a bar spoon. Garnish and serve.

parlourGame.description: The Parlour Game is a delightful Vermouth Sour that plays with the flavours of the Caribbean. Combining Monte Carlo Vermouth Rosso with Plantation 5 year Barbados Rum and Crème de Cacao Blanc, this cocktail offers a tropical twist with a touch of chocolate indulgence. The citrus notes from orange and lime juices blend harmoniously, topped off with the spicy warmth of pimento bitters. A must-try for those who enjoy a zesty and adventurous cocktail experience.
parlourGame.method: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker. Add cubed ice and shake vigorously until the cocktail is ice cold. Fine strain into a chilled sour glass and garnish with freshly grated nutmeg.

coteDazurCobbler.description: Playing off the rose notes of Monte Carlo Vermouth, this concoction is a new take on the classic sherry cobbler, adding apple and grapefruit to the mix for a brighter, more citrus experience.
recipe: 2.2 cl Eddu Eau de Vie de Pomme
coteDazurCobbler.method: Shake all ingredients with just one ice cube to mix them. Pour the cocktail into the glass and fill with pebble ice. Glassware: Rose Gold Julep Cup. Garnish: Add a straw and garnish with a mint plouche and a grapefruit slice.

monteCarloSpritz.description: This delightfully simple recipe tantalizes the palate, in an epiphany for the spritz lover. From whichever side of the marina you happen to be watching the sunset, the Monte-Carlo Spritz will anchor the moment into memory. The invigorating flavor of Monte-Carlo Vermouth is exalted by a splash of sumptuous prosecco, while the rose petal garnish hinting at its essence is delicately placed on the refreshing ice cube. A cocktail to discover and enjoy, at any time of the day.
monteCarloSpritz.method: Stir all ingredients over ice in a mixing glass and strain into the glass. Glassware: Coupette. Garnish: Express a grapefruit peel over the top of the cocktail. Garnish with a fresh cherry.

cherryBlossom.description: She’s not as sweet as she looks. Inspired by the classic Adonis cocktail from 1884, one of the first low ABV cocktails to become widely popular, this recipe brings out the floral flavors of Monte-Carlo Vermouth with bright cherry and anise from the absinthe, while the Supasawa adds a bit of acidity to encourage the next sip. Delicate yet complex, ideal before a meal, with oysters and seafood, or outside on a hot summer’s day.
cherryBlossom.method: Stir all ingredients over ice in a mixing glass and strain into the glass. Glassware: Coupette. Garnish: Express a grapefruit peel over the top of the cocktail. Garnish with a fresh cherry.

productsCollection.description2: Vermouth Rosso is infused with bitter orange peel, immortelle, timur pepper, orris and ginger.
productsCollection.description3: Vermouth Bianco includes bergamot, mandarin, and melon with delightful hints of bitter orange and grapefruit pith.

productsFinal.title: THE ART OF MIXOLOGY
productsFinal.description: Discover the versatility of Monte Carlo Vermouth through elegant cocktails, from timeless classics to inspired new creations.
